features: Android: a "Send clipboard" quick-settings tile. One tap sends whatever is on your clipboard, text or image, to your other devices.
improvements: Android: clips arriving from your other devices no longer make the screen flicker.
fixes: Android: copies made in Settings, banking apps and other protected screens now sync. Before, they were silently dropped.
Android: images sent from your Mac or PC can now be pasted even when Clippy isn't open.
